name: PocketConvoy
description: 🚗 Road-trip convoy web app: live map, push-to-talk and a shared route for a group of cars

paragraphs: A mobile-first web app that keeps a group of cars together on a road trip: live map of every car, push-to-talk walkie-talkie, a shared route set by the convoy leader, quick alerts, a speedometer and trip statistics with replay.

This is the demo version. The other cars of the convoy are simulated on the phone, so the whole app can be tested alone, without any server or account. Real-time sync between phones will be added once the behaviour is validated.
features: Full-screen live map with every car's speed and status. Dark and light map styles.
Shared pins: anyone can drop a pin (press and hold on the map) with a type and a name; the leader can turn it into a stop or the destination.
Turn-by-turn guidance on screen, rerouting when you leave the route.

Convoy alerts shown as large banners, each with its own sound: a car too far from the leader, the leader stopped, quick messages (break, fuel, lost, slow down, all good). A breakdown shows full screen. Convoy…
Adjustable haptic feedback (off, light, normal, strong) for buttons, walkie-talkie and alerts. Vibration on Android; on iPhone, Safari only allows a light tick (iOS 18 and later).
